name: cache-tax
description: Context, cache and rate-limit weather band above the prompt; warns when the prompt cache has likely gone cold; /ctx history, opt-in /keepwarm, and an automatic handoff document written from the warm cache before it expires or the context window fills.

cacheLifetimeMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheLifetimeMinutes.description: Idle minutes after which the prompt cache is assumed cold. Correct it from /ctx's measured estimate.

safetyMarginMinutes.title: Keep-warm safety margin (minutes)
safetyMarginMinutes.description: How long before the cache lifetime elapses a keep-warm refresh fires.

warnTokenThreshold.title: Warning token threshold
warnTokenThreshold.description: The cold-cache warning shows only when the context holds more tokens than this.

keepWarmMaxRefreshes.title: Keep-warm refresh cap
keepWarmMaxRefreshes.description: Most keep-warm refreshes in one idle stretch.

autoHandoff.title: Auto-handoff before the cache expires
autoHandoff.description: Just before an idle session's prompt cache expires (or at the keep-warm cap), and once when the context window is nearly full, fork the session into a handoff document under ~/.claude/handoffs/.

lowContextPercent.title: Last-chance handoff: % of context left
lowContextPercent.description: Hand off once when this much of the context window or less is left (auto-compact off means a full window ends the session). 0 turns it off.
